## TemplateEngine.\_extractBlock() method

Extracts specific blocks from template content with optional filtering.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _extractBlock(content: string, blocks?: string | string[], baseId?: string, section?: `all` | `value`, lang?: string): string;
```

## Remarks

This internal method extracts content from templates based on base ID, block type, language, and section mode. It supports scoped extraction with indentation normalization for clean output.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base id="main">
    <message>Hello</message>
    <keyboard>Yes, No</keyboard>
  </base>
`;
const result = TemplateEngine._extractBlock(template, 'message', 'main', 'value');
// Result: 'Hello'
```
